question: On the six selected 2020 XAUUSD dates, is prior-30-minute spread IQR more rank-associated with next-15-minute spread p95 than the preceding 15-minute spread p95?

method.exposure: Comparison chosen after inspecting the 2020 descriptive IQR/outcome result; no 2021 quote outcomes were opened.
method.paired_case_rule: For each consecutive 15-minute anchor pair within a date, compare current-anchor prior-30-minute spread IQR and previous-anchor forward-15-minute spread p95 against current-anchor forward-15-minute spread p95. The previous outcome window ends at the current anchor. Retain only pairs with both cases MEASURABLE; exclude the first anchor of each date.
method.metric: Within-day Spearman(IQR, next-15-minute p95) minus Spearman(previous-15-minute p95, next-15-minute p95); mean of six daily differences is descriptive. Day is the support unit, not overlapping anchors.
method.availability_mode: Retrospective event-time backfill; actual 2020 source availability is unverified. No historical replay or executable quote claim.

next_action: Do not open the six selected 2021 quote outcomes for this IQR candidate. Keep the date set unused for price validation unless a later candidate, its baseline and its measurement rules are frozen before access.
limitations: This is a development comparison selected after the earlier 2020 result was visible, not an independent test or a proof that IQR has no value.
Comparing two marginal rank correlations does not measure incremental predictive information conditional on the baseline.
Only six selected dates support the mean; 15-minute anchors overlap within dates.
No trading threshold, abstention value, broker quote fidelity or net economic payoff was evaluated.
